━━━ Company types · a village: what a larger settlement has is listed, not hidden ━━━
(edits message 42)
🏢 Register a company in Ostmarch

The registration fee goes to the city's treasury, and each period the company's upkeep is taken from its account. Choose the kind of business.

🏷 Grocery store - registration 1,000 SUP - upkeep 50 SUP per period
🔒 Restaurant - starts at a town; this is still a village. Needs: Market (level 1).
🔒 Factory - starts at a city; this is still a village. Needs: Factory.
🔒 Aerospace manufacturer - starts at a country; this is still a village. Needs: Workshop (level 4).
  ───
  [🏷 Grocery store] → company:type:grocery
  [🔙 Back] → company:list

━━━ Company type · not reached, a stage and a building role ━━━
(edits message 42)
🏷 Restaurant in Ostmarch

📍 Workplace: civic centre
💼 Hires into Retail
👥 Staff at most: 8
💰 Registration fee: 2,000 SUP
🔧 Upkeep: 80 SUP per period - a period lasts 1h

A company earns from the people of the city. Every shift your staff work raises its capacity and its quality; their wages are paid from the company's account.

🔒 Restaurant - starts at a town; this is still a village. Needs: Market (level 1).
  ───
  [🧭 Brennhaven] → travel:options:brennhaven
  [🔙 Back] → company:register
